statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-0990: xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI() recurses without bound when an XML catalog has a URI delegate entry that references itself, exhausting the stack (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/issues/1018). Debian fixed it for trixie in libxml2 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3, whose changelog reads "Fix CVE-2026-0990: `xmlCatalogXMLResolveURI()` will recurse infinitely if a catalog has a URI delegate referencing itself" (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-0990). The DHI libxml2 packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie libxml2. The rebuilds of 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u2 predate the fix; the first rebuild of 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3, used as the fixed version here, and every later build are built from that Debian release, and the Debian changelog shipped in the current libxml2 package (read for amd64 and arm64) carries Debian's entry for this CVE.
